differences.native: MySQL uses REGEXP_LIKE with a case-sensitive word-boundary pattern for SNdddd-dddd.
differences.app: SQLite enumerates candidate offsets and checks the same prefix, digit groups, hyphen, and alphanumeric-or-underscore boundaries with SUBSTR and GLOB.
differences.rationale: SQLite lacks REGEXP_LIKE. DISTINCT collapses multiple matches in one description, preserving the native row filter, projection, and ordering.
